senses.gloss: jāpanā (Pkt. for Skt. yāp˚, cf. next; = AMg. jāvaṇa, nt., and JM. ˚ṇā, Sheth), sustenance, maintenance: kāyajāpanārthaṃ Śikṣ 〔131.8〕; (mahābhūtānāṃ) sthitaye jāpanāyai 〔137.9〕.
jāpayati (Pkt. for yāp˚, q.v., cf. prec. and 〔§ 2.34〕; = AMg. jāvei), lives, sustains life: kiyal-lūhenāpi bhojanena jāpayanti Śikṣ 〔130.11〕 (prose; ed. jñāp˚, corrected Transl. 〔p. 129, note 1〕).
